navigate.meaning: Opens or moves to another screen or area; nothing is submitted or changed.

local_choice.meaning: Picks a value on the current screen; no request leaves the device until a later submit.

toggle.meaning: Flips one reversible flag in place, such as a favourite.

submit.meaning: Commits input or starts work whose result the user waits for; every axis applies.

destructive.meaning: Removes or irreversibly changes something; every axis applies.
